name: devquora
description: Devquora — a minimal, developer-focused MERN blogging platform

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix frontend && npm run format --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ..
